newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: 5 killed 55 injured in El Salvador grenade blast.
newsitem.headline: 5 killed 55 injured in El Salvador grenade blast.

text.p: Five people were killed and 55 injured when a hand grenade exploded during a fight between rival gangs 13 miles (22 km) outside the capital San Salvador, police said on Monday.
Police said the fight broke out in the early hours of Sunday on the outskirts of the village of San Pedro Perulapan.
Three people died on the spot and two more died of their injuries, police said. Six of the 55 injured were in serious condition.
Many weapons of war were left in civilian hands after El Salvador's 12-year civil war ended in 1992.
